coordinator: Northgate Health IT (rotates annually under the charter)
approved_by: Federation Steering Committee (one seat per member hospital, one patient representative)
rationale: Every number below was agreed BEFORE any model was trained. The coordinator enforces it on every round. Changing it is a committee decision recorded in the charter, not a parameter a model author tunes.
evaluation_set: coordinator-held neutral set, 500 consented de-identified rows per member
notes: secure_aggregation true means the coordinator never sees an individual hospital's update: it cannot clip, reject, or use a robust aggregator (median, trimmed_mean, krum). Honest members clip their own updates to max_update_norm. Setting secure_aggregation to false gives the coordinator those defenses and also lets it read individual updates (see Lab 5b). The charter must choose.
